cases.translation: I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition с (off, from) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Погублю и людей, и скот, погублю и птиц в небесах, и рыбу в ___.
cases.translation: I will sweep away man and animal. I will sweep away the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the prepositional case indicates location in water.

cases.sentence: Я воздену руку над Иудеей и над жителями Иерусалима и сотру здесь последний след ___.
cases.translation: I will stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
cases.explain: The preposition отъ (from) or the notion of removing something requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я накажу в тот день всех, кто прыгает через ___, кто наполняет дом своих владык.
cases.translation: In that day, I will punish all those who leap over the threshold.
cases.explain: The preposition через (through, over) governs the accusative case, indicating movement across something.

cases.sentence: Тогда я обойду Иерусалим со светильниками в поисках людей и накажу ___.
cases.translation: It will happen at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with lamps, and I will punish the men.
cases.explain: The direct object of the verb накажу (will punish) requires the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Страшный шум поднимется в день Господа, даже храбрые воины будут кричать в ___.
cases.translation: There will be the noise of a cry; a wailing from the second quarter, and a great crashing from the hills.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the prepositional case indicates being in a state of fear.

cases.sentence: Ни серебро, ни золото не смогут спасти их в день гнева ___.
cases.translation: Neither their silver nor their gold will be able to deliver them in the day of Yahweh's wrath.
cases.explain: The possessive relationship requires the genitive case to show 'whose wrath.'

cases.sentence: В пламени его ревности сгорит вся ___.
cases.translation: for the whole land will be devoured by the fire of his jealousy.
cases.explain: The subject of the verb сгорит (will burn) requires the nominative case.

reading.ru: Слово Господа, которое было к Сафоне, сыну Кушия, сына Гедалии, сына Амария, сына Изекии, во время правления иудейского царя Иосии, сына Амона.
reading.question: To whom did the word of the Lord come?
reading.explain: The text opens with 'Yahweh's word which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi.'

reading.ru: Я все смету с лица земли, возвещает Господь.
reading.question: What does the Lord say He will do?
options: Sweep away everything from the earth
reading.correct: Sweep away everything from the earth
reading.explain: God says 'I will utterly sweep away everything from the surface of the earth.'

reading.ru: Погублю и людей, и скот, погублю и птиц в небесах, и рыбу в морях.
reading.question: What will be destroyed?
reading.explain: The text lists all creation: man, animal, birds of the sky, and fish of the sea.

reading.ru: Я воздену руку над Иудеей и над жителями Иерусалима.
reading.question: Against whom does the Lord stretch out His hand?
options: Against Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem
reading.correct: Against Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem
reading.explain: The Lord says 'I will stretch out my hand against Judah, and against all the inhabitants of Jerusalem.'

reading.ru: Умолкни перед владыкой Господом, так как близок день Господа.
reading.question: What should people do before the Lord, and why?
options: Be silent because the day of the Lord is near
reading.correct: Be silent because the day of the Lord is near
reading.explain: The verse says 'Be silent at the presence of the Lord Yahweh, for the day of Yahweh is at hand.'

reading.ru: Внезапный конец положит он всем, кто живет на земле.
reading.question: What will the Lord do to those living on earth?
options: Make a sudden end to all inhabitants of the earth
reading.correct: Make a sudden end to all inhabitants of the earth
reading.explain: The text states 'he will make an end, yes, a terrible end, of all those who dwell in the land.'
